title: Return the Woodsman
description: Tomas is alive, walking on his own, saying little. Bring him home to his wife and let her see for herself instead of taking a stranger's word for it.

objectives.description: Bring Tomas home to his wife in Elder Moor

notes: Closing beat pays off the wife's fear plainly - he comes home, she sees him, nothing is undercut or complicated. This is the chain deliberately left without a twist.
